model: 66 edge coordinates; M=m I; K=k (d1.T d1+d2 d2.T); damping diagonal in these modes
units: dimensionless ratio; SI seconds, metres, kg or N/m in input
acceptance: absolute standardized residual <=3; otherwise conditional model rejected; agreement alone does not identify a TOE
required_assumptions: uniform independently checked edge masses and stiffnesses
uncertainty includes fit and mode-dependent systematic errors
baseline: Unconstrained two-mode ratio; no Bayes factor assigned without a predictive baseline distribution
scope: Conditional engineered-substrate test. Not a prediction of a fundamental constant or a completed TOE; no unseen observations available.
